## Notes on the braid

**Independence of the world plot.** Suppose Sahra and Yannu had settled it in
ch 5 and stayed happy. The Whiting is still full. The returns still come up
oldest-first through the fen. Sarrow-under-Wall still dies in Rime. Bel Osse
still seals the finding to save the currency, and the Shelf still has eleven
hours and no sink on 24 Deepwinter. Every stake in the A plot is a stake
about where eighty thousand people put what they take out of their water, and
none of it is about who marries whom.

**One climax, not two.** The single action at ch_44 is the ten-hour live pass
at the Wallow. What it does to the world plot: it empties the live edge, saves
the Third Reach and the Sarrow and Amrith's cisterns, and proves in front of
the Chief Reckoner that a load can be *ended* in a setter rather than stored
in ground — which is the beginning of the only answer the Shelf will ever
have. What it does to the relationship: performed on the House's account and
witnessed by a reckoner, it is credited at the assessed rate — 2,306 carries
against 2,140 outstanding — which discharges the Ottun Composition in the
field ledger before the tide covers the desk. There is no second scene in
which the couple is separately resolved. There is no third party who lifts
anything. The same hands do both things at the same hour and are ruined by it.

**On the barrier and the system it is made of.** It is worth stating plainly,
because it governs every row above: this book has no version in which two
people are kept apart by an unlucky contract that happens to sit near a magic
system. The Ottun entry is not an amount of value — it is 2,140 units of a
bodily faculty, and the carry is the Shelf's unit of account precisely
because capacity cannot be minted, warehoused, shipped, or held by anyone but
the person born able to hold it. Strike the Draw out of this world and the
writ measures nothing, the Reckoning House becomes a building of clerks with
no faculty to assay, and the Third Order becomes a procedure for merging
estates with no reason to merge. And the instrument would not even be a
*betrothal*: compositions run through marriage because capacity is the one
asset on the Shelf that can be conveyed by no other means — it lives in a
body and it descends through a bloodline, which is why the 1201 assessment
attaches to *the drawing line of Ottun* rather than to a parcel or a purse,
and why the name of a fourteen-year-old girl is in the schedule. An
obligation that can only be pledged by producing a person who carries it can
only be settled by the instrument that produces people. Take away the Draw
and the debt has nothing to attach to, no reason to follow Yeshin, and no
reason to be settled in a marriage rather than a payment. The chain from
Ines Ottun's eleventh carry to her granddaughter's witnessing is made of the
magic at every link, which is exactly why the same ten hours that empty the
Wallow are the ten hours that strike the entry.
